marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind south 25 knots diminishing to south 15 late overnight then
veering to west 20 Saturday evening. Fog patches forming after midnight and dissipating near
noon Saturday. Temperatures near zero. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 2 metres subsiding to 1 early Saturday
morning.<br/>
